name: io.github.plus8bit/hosaka
description: Company facts for AI agents: domain age, mail and DNS providers, and every third-party vendor a company can be proven to use, each with the DNS record or script that proves it. Paid per call in USDC on Base, no signup and no API key.

environmentVariables.name: HOSAKA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet holding a little USDC on Base. It signs payments locally and never leaves the machine.

environmentVariables.name: HOSAKA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the shop endpoint. Defaults to https://hosaka-agents.vercel.app
